title: Fiko Becomes Brave
moral: Taking small steps can help you overcome fear.

scenes.summary: Fiko the frog enjoys playing but is afraid of trying new things.
scenes.text:
Fiko the Frog Who Carried Fear

In a green pond surrounded by tall grass, lived a little frog named Fiko.

Fiko loved jumping and playing.

But there was one problem…

Fiko was afraid of trying new things.

scenes.summary: Fiko refuses to try jumping to the big rock because of fear.
scenes.text:
“Let’s jump to the big rock!” said Lumi the Duck.

Fiko shook his head.

“What if I fall?” he said.

“I’ll stay here.”
scenes.image_prompt: duck encouraging frog to jump while frog looks scared, colorful cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Fiko watches others have fun but stays back due to fear.
scenes.text:
Lumi and the others jumped happily.

Splash! Hop! Splash!

Fiko watched from the side.

“That looks fun,” he said.

scenes.summary: Fiko decides to try a small jump with encouragement from Lumi.
scenes.text:
One day, Lumi said,

“Try a small jump first.”

Fiko looked at a tiny rock nearby.

“Maybe… I can try that,” he said.

Fiko bent his legs.

Hop!

He landed on the small rock.

“I did it!” he said.
scenes.image_prompt: frog successfully jumping onto small rock with duck cheering, cute cartoon

scenes.summary: Fiko gains confidence and reaches the big rock.
scenes.text:
Fiko tried a bigger jump.

Then an even bigger one.

Soon, he reached the big rock!

Fiko smiled.

“I was scared,” he said,

“but trying helped me!”

Take small steps when you feel afraid.

They lead to big success.

The End

story:
Fiko the Frog Who Carried Fear

In a green pond surrounded by tall grass, lived a little frog named Fiko.

Fiko loved jumping and playing.

But there was one problem…

Fiko was afraid of trying new things.

“Let’s jump to the big rock!” said Lumi the Duck.

Fiko shook his head.

“What if I fall?” he said.

“I’ll stay here.”

Lumi and the others jumped happily.

Splash! Hop! Splash!

Fiko watched from the side.

“That looks fun,” he said.

But he didn’t try.

One day, Lumi said,

“Try a small jump first.”

Fiko looked at a tiny rock nearby.

“Maybe… I can try that,” he said.

Fiko bent his legs.

Hop!

He landed on the small rock.

“I did it!” he said.

Fiko tried a bigger jump.

Then an even bigger one.

Soon, he reached the big rock!

Fiko smiled.

“I was scared,” he said,

“but trying helped me!”

Take small steps when you feel afraid.

They lead to big success.

The End
